props.headline: Find out exactly what's holding your training back
props.sub: A short call with a coach: we look at your sport, your schedule and your history, then tell you the straight answer on what to train next — whether or not you work with us.

props.heading: What the call actually covers
props.intro: No sales script. Twenty focused minutes on your training.

items.title: Where you are now
items.body: Your sport, training age, current week, and anything that hurts or has hurt.

items.title: What's limiting you
items.body: The one or two things — strength, power, movement, or load management — most likely capping your performance.

items.title: What to do next
items.body: A concrete recommendation you can act on, in person or online, with or without us.

steps.title: Send your details
steps.body: Sport, goal, availability and any injury history. Two minutes.

steps.title: Pick a time
steps.body: We come back with call times, usually within 48 hours.

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.body: Twenty minutes on the phone or video. You leave with a plan either way.

items.a: No. It's free and there's no obligation to buy anything afterwards.
It's a coaching conversation. We tell you what we'd do in your position. If we're not the right fit, we say so and point you elsewhere.

items.q: I'm currently injured — should I still book?
items.a: Yes. Bring the details of the injury and where you are in rehab. We coach a lot of athletes returning to sport and will tell you honestly whether now is the right time to add load.

items.q: I'm a beginner. Is this only for serious athletes?
items.a: It's for anyone who trains with a goal. Youth athletes, adults returning to sport and complete beginners all book these calls.

items.q: Do I have to train in person?
items.a: No. We coach both in person and online, and the call will cover which suits your schedule better.

items.q: How long until I hear back?
items.a: Usually within 48 hours with a set of times to choose from.

props.headline: Twenty minutes now can save you a wasted season
props.sub: Free, no obligation, and you leave with a clear next step.
